meta_description: Central Electrical Nottingham provides qualified domestic and commercial electrical work, repairs, and installations. Fast, reliable service across Nottingham. Call today.
hero_subhead: Faulty wiring, tripped circuits, or a full rewire needed? Central Electrical responds fast and gets the job done right, first time.
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to planned installations, we handle domestic and commercial electrical work with speed and skill.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped electrics, or live hazards? We're on call 24/7 to diagnose and fix faults fast, often on the same day.

services.title: Domestic Rewiring
services.desc: Complete house rewires including full inspection, upgrade to modern safety standards, and certification for insurance and sale purposes.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Electrics
services.desc: Installation and repair of electrical components for heating systems, immersion heaters, and smart heating controls.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Replace old fuse boxes with modern circuit breaker units that meet current regulations and provide better protection.

services.title: Testing & Certification
services.desc: EICR (electrical installation condition reports) for lettings, sales, and workplace compliance — full paperwork included.

services.title: New Installations & Extensions
services.desc: Adding sockets, lighting, or powering a kitchen extension safely and to Building Regulations. All work certified and guaranteed.

about_pullquote: I started Central Electrical because I saw too many cowboys cutting corners on safety.
about_para_1: Central Electrical was founded in 2006 with one aim: give Nottingham homeowners and businesses an electrician they could trust. Over 18 years, we've completed over 2,000 jobs across the city — from emergency callouts at midnight to full rewires on new builds. Every electrician on our team is NICEIC registered and trained to the latest safety standards.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up on time, doing the job properly, and charging a fair price with no hidden fees. We don't upsell or rush; we diagnose the real problem, explain what needs doing, and let you decide. Customers come back to us because they know we'll treat their home the way we'd treat our own.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had an issue with our consumer unit — lights kept tripping out and we didn't know why. Called Central Electrical on a Friday afternoon and they were round the same day. Turned out to be a faulty MCB. Cost half what I'd expected and came with a certificate. Really professional bloke, didn't take the mickey.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: We were buying a flat and needed an EICR done. Got the report back quickly with clear recommendations. Seller's electrician had missed several things. Brilliant peace of mind, and the price was very fair. Would use again.
reviews.author: Emma W.

reviews.text: Emergency call on a Sunday evening — boiler had stopped heating and I thought it was an electrical fault. Got someone round within an hour, found it was the immersion heater trip. Fixed it, showed me how to reset it, and charged a reasonable call-out fee. Can't fault them. Proper service.
reviews.author: Mark T.
